messages:
alex: need a quick changewindow exception — trying to roll out a canary + A/B traffic split for the model-routing policy. want to push 5% traffic to variant B for 2 hours to compare latency/cost. it hits the normal change window cutoff at 18:00 PT though

mira: what guard thresholds are you asking for?

alex: plan is: 5% split, 1% incremental ramp per minute, health guard on 95th p50 latency (alert if > +50ms) and error rate > 0.5%. rollout config: ```/deploy-bot rollout create --name routing-ab-2026-03-18 --split 5:95 --ramp 1%/min --guards "latency:95p:+50ms,error:rate:0.5%" --duration 2h```

sam: change window exception required from eng-releases owners, and product for metric/qa signoff. do we need legal/compliance?

alex: not for this one — no user data change. just routing between two model variants (open models). product signoff from mira should cover QA side.

mira: eyeballed the dashboard, +1 if we have a rollback plan and additional telemetry on per-route cost. can we emit a temporary tag so Optimize can attribute costs?

alex: yes, will add tag `experiment:routing-ab-2026-03-18` to both routes. also enable verbose telemetry for KV cache hits for the canary group.

dana: FYI deploy-bot will block if changewindow is closed. can we schedule for 19:00 PT instead to avoid override?

alex: we need data sooner — if we can't get an exception, will run a smaller synthetic benchmark in the staging fleet. but prefer prod canary.

jorge: + from me for change window exception if sam and mira approve. also add a smoke test that queries the routing decision endpoint every 30s to ensure fairness.

sam: ok from my side assuming rollback threshold: abort if error rate > 0.5% for 5 consecutive minutes OR latency 95p > +100ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

mira: approved for product. ensure the dashboard has these thresholds as widgets and set a temporary alert to my phone.

alex: thanks — requesting exception now. /deploy-bot request-changewindow-exception --reason "experiment routing A/B for latency/cost" --owner "eng-releases" --requested-by alex --start 1763458800 --end 1763466000

deploy-bot: changewindow exception request received (id: cw-20260318-11). automated checks: schedule conflict none; required approvals: eng-releases, product. current approvers: sam, mira.

mira: approved in threads. :white_check_mark:

sam: approved. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: approval complete. exception cw-20260318-11 granted by approvers [mira, sam]. note: canary guard still enforces rate ramps. executing rollout in 60s.

alex: kicking off now. command: ```/deploy-bot rollout start cw-20260318-11 routing-ab-2026-03-18```

deploy-bot: rollout started. split=5:95, ramp=1%/min, guards={latency95:+50ms,errorRate:0.5%}. monitoring: infra.dashboard/redwood/rollouts/cw-20260318-11 -> shared in #eng-releases

jorge: adding a scripted smoke run now. snippet: ```while true; do curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/v1/routing/decision | jq .variant; sleep 30; done```

alex: first 1% bump looks clean. p50/p95 within baseline. KV cache hit-rate stable. tagging optimize with experiment key.

dana: note — ops traced a small spike in redis connections at 1% ramp, watching. if it goes beyond 3% ramp will throttle.

deploy-bot: guard triggered? check logs: ``ERROR: guard-throttle: ramp limit reached at 3% due to redis connection spike``

alex: observed — halting ramp temporarily and opening a rollback window. will pause at current split until ops confirms.

jorge: rolling back to 0% in 2m if ops can't stabilize.

dana: investigating now, pushing a config tweak to connection pool: ```redis.pool.max=120 -> 200``` will deploy to staging then prod within 10m.

sam: thanks for quick ops. keep product in the loop. mira, alex can update on whether to continue after patch.

alex: agreed. will resume after confirmation. logging incident in postmortems if rollback occurs.

mira: thanks all. great cross-team response. remember to add a short blameless note for the retrospective.

deploy-bot: cw-20260318-11 status=paused at split=3% (reason=redis-spike). next action: manual resume or rollback by approver.
